Accessed September 4, 2014. | website = {{nowrap|{{URL|https://www.bloomfieldtwpnj.com}}}} | footnotes = }} '''Bloomfield''' is a [[Township (New Jersey)|township]] in [[Essex County, New Jersey|Essex County]], in the [[U.S. state]] of [[New Jersey]], and an [[inner-ring suburb]] of [[Newark, New Jersey|Newark]]. As of the [[2020 United States census]], the township's population was 53,105, an increase of 5,790 (+12.2%) from the [[2010 United States census|2010 census]] count of 47,315, which in turn reflected a decline of 368 (-0.8%) from the 47,683 counted in the [[2000 United States census|2000 census]].[https://www.nj.gov/labor/labormarketinformation/assets/PDFs/census/2010/2010data/table7cm.xls Table 7. Population for the Counties and Municipalities in New Jersey: 1990, 2000 and 2010], [[New Jersey Department of Labor and Workforce Development]], February 2011. Accessed May 1, 2023. It is the location of the [[Bloomfield Green Historic District]], which was added to the [[National Register of Historic Places]] in 1978.[https://www.nj.gov/dep/hpo/1identify/nrsr_lists/ESSEX.pdf New Jersey and National Registers of Historic Places - Essex County], [[New Jersey Department of Environmental Protection]] Historic Preservation Office, updated March 25, 2024. Accessed April 5, 2024.
